paragraphs.text: Teachers have long complained that noisy classrooms make learning harder, but until recently there were few measurements. A team from Tarrow College placed sound meters in 40 primary classrooms for a whole term.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The average level during lessons was 65 decibels, roughly the volume of a busy restaurant. Surprisingly, most of the noise did not come from outside traffic but from inside the room: chairs scraping on hard floors, heating systems and, of course, the children themselves.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Pupils sitting at the back of noisy rooms scored lower on listening tests than those at the front, and the gap was widest for children who were learning English as an additional language. Teachers in the loudest rooms also reported more sore throats and days off work.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Some solutions proved simple. Felt pads on chair legs reduced the noise level by several decibels, and panels on the ceiling absorbed echo. The researchers point out that these measures cost far less than rebuilding a school, and they recommend that sound levels be checked whenever a classroom is redesigned.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: placed sound meters in 40 primary classrooms for a whole term

options.text: in one school for a whole year.

explanation.en: “sound meters in 40 primary classrooms for a whole term” → A. The schools were primary, not secondary (D), and it lasted a term, not a year (B).
explanation.kk: «sound meters in 40 primary classrooms for a whole term» → A. Мектептер орта емес (D), бастауыш; мерзімі жыл емес (B), бір тоқсан.
explanation.ru: «sound meters in 40 primary classrooms for a whole term» → A. Школы начальные, а не средние (D), и срок — четверть, а не год (B).

items.quote: most of the noise did not come from outside traffic but from inside the room
items.prompt: Most of the noise in the classrooms came from

explanation.en: “did not come from outside traffic but from inside the room” → B. A is the trap: traffic is mentioned as where the noise did NOT come from.
explanation.kk: «did not come from outside traffic but from inside the room» → B. A — тұзақ: көлік дәл шу шықпаған көз ретінде аталады.
explanation.ru: «did not come from outside traffic but from inside the room» → B. A — ловушка: транспорт упомянут именно как то, откуда шум НЕ шёл.

items.quote: the gap was widest for children who were learning English as an additional language
items.prompt: Which pupils were most affected by noise in listening tests?

options.text: those learning English as an additional language
those who often had sore throats

explanation.en: “the gap was widest for children who were learning English as an additional language” → C. Sore throats (D) were the teachers’, and pupils at the front (A) did better.
explanation.kk: «the gap was widest for children who were learning English as an additional language» → C. Тамақ ауруы (D) мұғалімдерде болған, ал алдыңғы партадағылар (A) жақсырақ нәтиже көрсеткен.
explanation.ru: «the gap was widest for children who were learning English as an additional language» → C. Больное горло (D) было у учителей, а сидящие впереди (A) справлялись лучше.

items.quote: Felt pads on chair legs reduced the noise level by several decibels

options.text: were too expensive for most schools.
replaced the need for ceiling panels.

explanation.en: “Felt pads on chair legs reduced the noise level by several decibels” → C. The text stresses these measures are cheap, so A is wrong; ceiling panels are a separate measure (D).
explanation.kk: «Felt pads on chair legs reduced the noise level by several decibels» → C. Мәтінде бұл шаралар арзан екені айтылған, сондықтан A қате; төбедегі панель — бөлек шара (D).
explanation.ru: «Felt pads on chair legs reduced the noise level by several decibels» → C. В тексте подчёркнуто, что меры дешёвые, так что A неверен; панели на потолке — отдельная мера (D).

items.quote: they recommend that sound levels be checked whenever a classroom is redesigned

options.text: checking sound levels when a classroom is redesigned
moving pupils to the front of the room

explanation.en: “they recommend that sound levels be checked whenever a classroom is redesigned” → B. Rebuilding schools (A) is mentioned as the expensive option, not a recommendation.
explanation.kk: «they recommend that sound levels be checked whenever a classroom is redesigned» → B. Мектепті қайта салуды (A) олар ұсыныс ретінде емес, қымбат жол ретінде атайды.
explanation.ru: «they recommend that sound levels be checked whenever a classroom is redesigned» → B. Перестройку школ (A) они упоминают как дорогой путь, а не рекомендацию.
